label: input x at steps 3-5 of a sequence starting with 2
explanation: Very sparse feature (about 0.004% of steps). It fires almost only in the original phase (98% of mass) on the token x (82% of mass) at steps 3-5 (mostly t=4), in sequences whose first token is 2 (92% of mass). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<3. The strongest activations are on x after a 2-initial prefix that also contains digits or u/f/n/l (e.g. 2 l 0 u x, 2 2 0 f x, 2 d 0 0 x). Many 2...x sequences do not activate it, so precision is low (about 12% on dev); adding a prefix-content condition raises precision to about 28% but loses recall. The remaining weak activations fall on other tokens (o, e, u, <DEL>) after similar 2/l-initial digit-rich prefixes.
